1. According to Institute observations, Vein energy has been unusually active in some regions lately, causing special changes in the local ecosystem.
2. During the event, in the first 3 Nurture runs you do each weekend in the designated area, the chance for Nova Stage Aniimo to appear will greatly increase. After harvesting Veinfruit, your area Prismana gain is boosted by an additional 50 %.
Doing Nurture increases the area’s Prismatic Energy. When you capture Aniimo, you also have a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike, which increases the area’s Prismatic Energy.
Each time the area’s Prismatic Energy increases through Nurture, there is a 3% chance to trigger a Prismana Flow, attracting local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
Each time you capture an Aniimo and trigger a Lucky Strike, increasing the region’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 0.6% chance to trigger a Prismana Flow, attracting local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
3. Every weekend, abundant Vein energy will also draw large numbers of Aniimo to gather in the designated area. Head there to explore and capture them.
4. During the event, some special Prismana Aniimo will also be drawn by Vein energy and appear for a limited time in designated areas. Check the event schedule below for which Prismana Aniimo appear in each phase and where.

When the Alpha Irisal was still an Iris, the former Alpha left it with a kid from Bloomville. The kid’s name was Clovis, a florist of Bloomville, born with a special perception of life. They became partners—the Irisal’s job was to dance on the flower fields to help them grow while Clovis perceived the status of each plant in order to make proper plans for cultivating them.
It was just another day, Clovis suddenly gave it a hair band. It turns out that a couple of days before, Clovis was given an urgent order, so he had to ask two other Irises for help and treated them with lots of nectar. But Clovis didn’t forget about his good friend. Floret did not know why it felt so sad, but Clovis noticed. He told it the prettiest hair band was for his best friend, Floret, and there was only one like it in the world.
Since Floret evolved into an Irisal, it also grew out of the hair band. But it still carries it wherever it goes.
